usageRules:
The beneficiary's bank details (IBAN, or bank code / branch code / account number) are not recognised by the account servicer.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The beneficiary's bank details are not recognised, or cannot be used by the bank.
likelyCauses: Data-entry error in the third-party master data
recommendedActions: Check the beneficiary's IBAN
Ask the beneficiary to confirm their bank details
Update the third-party master data
Resubmit once corrected
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the beneficiary's bank details appear to be invalid. Please confirm a valid IBAN.

usageRules:
The beneficiary's account does not exist.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The beneficiary account given does not exist, or is not recognised by the bank.
recommendedActions: Check the bank details
Ask the beneficiary for an up-to-date IBAN
Correct and resubmit
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the beneficiary's bank account does not exist or was not recognised. Please send us a valid IBAN.

usageRules:
The customer has closed out the account, or the account has been closed or transferred to another branch of the bank or of the banking group.
Applies to returns.
description: The beneficiary's account is no longer active or usable.
likelyCauses: Outdated IBAN in the master data
recommendedActions: Ask the beneficiary for an up-to-date IBAN
Update the third-party master data
Resubmit once corrected
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the beneficiary's bank account appears to be closed or out of date. Please send us an up-to-date IBAN.

standardLabel: Account blocked or under a stop order
usageRules:
The beneficiary's account is subject to a stop order or is blocked. The date of the stop order must precede the interbank settlement date of the transaction.
Applies to returns.
plainLanguageLabel: Account blocked or under a stop order
description: The beneficiary's account cannot receive the transaction because it is blocked or subject to a stop order.
likelyCauses: Administrative or court-ordered freeze on the account
recommendedActions: Contact the beneficiary for clarification
Ask whether alternative bank details are available
Resubmit only once confirmed
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the beneficiary's account is blocked or subject to a stop. Please tell us how to proceed, or send us new bank details.

usageRules:
Originator's account closed out / closed.
Applies to rejects.
In a B2B direct debit (SDD B2B), AC13 has another meaning (CFONB 31): the debtor's account is a consumer account, which is incompatible with that scheme.
description: The originating account used to issue the transaction is no longer active.
likelyCauses: Wrong account used in the file
Outdated configuration on the sending side
recommendedActions: Check the debtor account used
Update the account configuration
Resubmit the file with the correct account
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the debit account used is no longer active. Please check the account the payment was issued from.

usageRules:
Transaction forbidden.
Applies to rejects.
description: The transaction is not allowed in the current processing context.
recommendedActions: Check the nature of the transaction
Review the applicable permissions or restrictions
Contact the bank if needed
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was rejected because it is not permitted in this context. The settings or the applicable rules need to be checked.

usageRules:
Transaction not authorised.
Applies to rejects.
description: The transaction does not carry the authorisation needed to be executed.
recommendedActions: Check the authorisations and permissions
Review the bank-side configuration
Correct the context before reprocessing
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the operation is not allowed. Please check the permissions or the related settings.

usageRules:
Technical error.
Applies to rejects.
description: The transaction failed for a generic technical reason.
recommendedActions: Check whether the incident is temporary
Review the technical feedback available
Resubmit later if the context allows
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected for a technical reason. Please try again later or contact support.

usageRules:
Technical error.
Applies to rejects.
description: The rejection relates to an unspecified technical incident.
recommendedActions: Review the logs or technical feedback available
Contact support if the problem persists
Resubmit once cleared
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected for a technical reason. A further check may be needed before it is processed again.

usageRules:
Technical error.
Applies to rejects.
description: The system rejected the transaction for a generic technical reason.
recommendedActions: Check the technical context
Contact support if necessary
Resubmit once the incident is cleared
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was rejected for a technical reason. Please check the processing environment before trying again.

usageRules:
Invalid amount.
Applies to rejects.
description: The amount submitted is not acceptable in the context of the payment.
likelyCauses: Does not meet the processing rules
recommendedActions: Check the value and format of the amount
Check the decimals and the currency where applicable
Correct and resubmit
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the amount submitted is invalid. Please correct the value before submitting it again.

description: The account to be debited does not hold enough funds to execute the transaction.
likelyCauses: Other debits cleared before this transaction
recommendedActions: Check the available balance
Fund the account if necessary
Resubmit once the situation is resolved
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was rejected because of insufficient funds. Please check the balance before submitting it again.
usageRules:
Insufficient funds, in whole or in part.
Applies to returns for SCT, and to negative responses to the Recall and RFRO procedures.

Transaction submitted in duplicate.
Applies to rejects.
description: The bank considers that the transaction has already been sent or recorded.
likelyCauses: Same transaction sent more than once
File resubmitted without a uniqueness check
recommendedActions: Check that the payment reference is unique
Check whether the transaction has already been processed
Resubmit only after confirmation
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was rejected as a duplicate. Please check whether the payment has already been sent or executed.

usageRules:
Invalid amount.
Applies to rejects.
description: The transaction amount does not pass the expected checks.
likelyCauses: Problem in how the file was built
recommendedActions: Check the amount submitted
Check the XML or business format
Correct and resubmit
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the amount entered is not valid. Please check the value before submitting it again.

usageRules:
Mismatch on the account holder.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The account holder's name or identity does not match the expected checks.
likelyCauses: Beneficiary name inconsistent with the account
Enhanced verification on the bank side
recommendedActions: Check the account holder details
Compare the account name with the beneficiary name
Correct the information and resubmit if appropriate
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because the account holder's identity does not match. Please check the details that were sent.

usageRules:
Settlement of the SEPA credit transfer failed.
Applies to rejects.
description: Interbank settlement of the transaction could not be completed.
likelyCauses: Settlement failure somewhere in the interbank chain
Technical problem at the bank or in clearing
recommendedActions: Check whether the incident is widespread or isolated
Contact the bank
Resubmit only once resolution is confirmed
userMessageTemplate: The payment could not be settled between the banks. A further check with the bank is needed.

usageRules:
Account holder deceased (beneficiary).
Applies to returns.
description: The bank reports that the beneficiary account holder has died.
recommendedActions: Put the payment on hold
Contact the administrative contact or the estate file
Obtain new instructions before any resubmission
userMessageTemplate: The payment could not be made because the bank reported that the account holder has died. Please let us know how you would like us to proceed.

usageRules:
The receiving bank does not give a specific reason.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The bank rejected or returned the transaction without giving a usable, detailed reason.
likelyCauses: Internal reason not detailed by the bank
recommendedActions: Check the other information available in the reporting
Contact the bank if the case recurs
Verify the transaction data before resubmitting
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected and the bank gave no detailed reason. A further check is needed.

usageRules:
BIC of the receiving bank unusable.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The bank code or BIC of the receiving bank cannot be used.
recommendedActions: Check the BIC and the related bank details
Correct the master data if necessary
Resubmit once corrected
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected because of an incorrect bank code or BIC. Please check the bank details.

usageRules:
Reject/return on regulatory / compliance grounds.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The transaction was blocked on compliance or regulatory grounds.
recommendedActions: Consult the compliance team or the bank
Check the counterparty data
Do not resubmit without prior clearance
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was blocked for a regulatory or compliance reason. Further review is needed before it can be processed again.

usageRules:
Reject/return on regulatory grounds.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The transaction was rejected on unspecified regulatory grounds.
likelyCauses: Data not meeting a regulatory requirement
recommendedActions: Contact the bank for details
Check the transaction and party data
Wait for clearance before reprocessing
userMessageTemplate: The payment was rejected for a regulatory reason. Please contact the bank or your compliance team.

usageRules:
Reject/return on regulatory grounds.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The transaction could not be executed because of a regulatory check.
recommendedActions: Review the case with the bank
Check the counterparty data
Do not resubmit until the cause is clarified
userMessageTemplate: The transaction is blocked for a regulatory reason. Clarification from the bank is needed.

usageRules:
File received after the cut-off time.
Applies to rejects.
description: The file or transaction arrived after the processing cut-off time.
recommendedActions: Check the applicable cut-off times
Send earlier on the next batches
Present the transaction again in the next available window
userMessageTemplate: The file was received after the processing cut-off time. Please submit it again in the next available window.

usageRules:
The transaction could not be processed within the time limit applying to SCT Inst.
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
plainLanguageLabel: Timed out at the beneficiary's bank
description: The beneficiary's bank did not respond within the maximum time allowed for an instant credit transfer. The transaction is cancelled.
likelyCauses: Response time too long at the beneficiary's bank
Overload or one-off incident in its system
Latency between the clearing system and that bank
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the instant payment again a little later
If rejections to this bank keep recurring, use a standard SEPA credit transfer
userMessageTemplate: The beneficiary's bank did not reply in time. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again.

usageRules:
The maximum execution time (time-out) recorded by one of the parties involved has been exceeded.
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
plainLanguageLabel: Timed out at the instructed agent
description: The agent the message was sent to (clearing system or intermediary bank) did not process the transaction within the maximum time. The transaction is cancelled.
likelyCauses: Load peak on the processing chain
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the instant payment again a little later
If it keeps happening, ask your bank whether the clearing system has an ongoing incident
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was not processed in time by an intermediary. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again.

usageRules:
Any one of the parties involved in processing the SCT Inst is unavailable.
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
description: One of the parties in the payment chain could not be reached at the time of the transaction. This is a generic code, used when it cannot be determined exactly which party is unavailable.
likelyCauses: Scheduled maintenance of a party in the chain
Party temporarily disconnected from the clearing system
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the instant payment again later
If the outage lasts, ask your bank which party is involved
userMessageTemplate: An intermediary in the payment chain cannot be reached. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again later.

usageRules:
The beneficiary's bank is unavailable to provide the service (offline).
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
description: The beneficiary's bank could not be reached at the time of the transaction, so the transaction could not be passed on to it. This is not a timeout.
likelyCauses: Scheduled maintenance at the beneficiary's bank
Outage or lost connection to the clearing system
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the instant payment again later
If the outage lasts, use a standard SEPA credit transfer
userMessageTemplate: The beneficiary's bank cannot be reached at the moment. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again later or use a standard credit transfer.

usageRules:
Processing error at the beneficiary's bank.
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
description: The beneficiary's bank hit an error while processing the transaction, which was therefore stopped.
likelyCauses: Technical error in the beneficiary bank's system
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the payment again once
If the error keeps recurring with this bank, contact your bank with the transaction reference
userMessageTemplate: The beneficiary's bank encountered an error. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again.

usageRules:
Processing error at the intermediary bank (a participant in the real-time clearing system).
Applies to rejects (SCT Inst).
description: The agent the message was sent to (clearing system or intermediary bank) hit an error, and the transaction was stopped.
likelyCauses: Technical error in the clearing system (CSM)
Message the agent could not process
recommendedActions: Check that the amount was not debited, or was credited back
Send the payment again once
If the error keeps recurring, contact your bank with the transaction reference
userMessageTemplate: An intermediary in the payment chain encountered an error. The instant credit transfer has been cancelled, and you can send it again.

usageRules:
The debtor disputes the transaction for want of consent (mandate missing, revoked or lapsed).
Applies to rejects, returns and refunds of an unauthorised transaction.
description: The debtor disputes the transaction for want of a valid direct debit mandate: no mandate, revoked, or lapsed.
likelyCauses: Mandate never signed, or never sent
Mandate lapsed — 36 months without a collection
recommendedActions: Check that the SEPA mandate exists and is valid
Obtain a new mandate if needed before collecting again
Contact the debtor to clarify the dispute
userMessageTemplate: The debtor disputes the transaction as no valid mandate exists. A new mandate is required before any further collection.

usageRules:
One or more pieces of mandate data are missing or incorrect.
Applies to rejects.
description: One or more pieces of mandate information — reference, signature date, identifier — is missing or incorrect.
likelyCauses: Unique Mandate Reference (UMR) missing or malformed
Mandate signature date missing or inconsistent
Mismatch between the data sent and the mandate held by the debtor
recommendedActions: Check the UMR and the signature date submitted
Compare them with the original mandate
Correct and re-issue the collection
userMessageTemplate: The mandate data submitted is incomplete or incorrect. Please correct it before sending again.

usageRules:
The debtor disputes an authorised transaction within 8 weeks of the debit.
Applies to refunds.
Concerns SDD Core: the B2B scheme gives no such right to a refund.
description: The debtor disputes an authorised transaction within eight weeks of the debit and requests a refund.
likelyCauses: Commercial disagreement between debtor and creditor
Debtor does not recognise the amount or the service
Routine refund request within the legal SDD Core window
recommendedActions: Check the merits of the dispute with the debtor
Review the related service or invoice
Expect an automatic refund by the debtor's bank
userMessageTemplate: The debtor disputed an authorised transaction within the eight-week window and receives an automatic refund. Check the reason with your customer.

usageRules:
On the customer's instruction / debtor refusal.
Applies to the debtor's refusal before settlement, rejects, returns and reversals.
description: The debtor explicitly asked their bank to refuse, reject, return or reverse this collection.
likelyCauses: Debtor placed a one-off stop on the collection
Explicit refusal communicated to the debtor's bank
Debtor disagrees with this particular instalment
recommendedActions: Contact the debtor to understand the refusal
Decide whether presenting it again makes sense
Review the commercial relationship if refusals recur
userMessageTemplate: The debtor explicitly asked their bank to refuse this collection. Sending it again without the debtor's agreement will most likely be refused too.

usageRules:
Invalid file format.
Applies to rejects.
description: The collection file or message submitted does not meet the expected format.
likelyCauses: XML structure not compliant with the pain.008 schema
Encoding or forbidden characters in the file
recommendedActions: Validate the file against the pain.008 XSD schema
Correct the invalid fields or characters
Regenerate and re-issue the file
userMessageTemplate: The collection file submitted is invalid. Please correct its structure before sending again.

usageRules:
Specific service provided by the debtor's bank.
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The rejection or return stems from a specific service set up by the debtor's bank, such as selective blocking of direct debits.
likelyCauses: Creditor filter or whitelist enabled by the debtor
Specific configuration at the debtor's bank
recommendedActions: Ask the debtor to authorise the creditor with their bank
Check whether a filtering service is active
Contact the debtor's bank if you need details
userMessageTemplate: The rejection comes from a service enabled by the debtor's bank, such as creditor filtering. The debtor must authorise the creditor with their bank.

usageRules:
The SEPA Creditor Identifier is missing or inconsistent (for example, in its structure).
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The SEPA Creditor Identifier submitted is missing, or does not follow the expected structure.
likelyCauses: Creditor Identifier missing from the collection file
Identifier malformed, or matching no registered creditor
Configuration error in the issuing software
recommendedActions: Check the Creditor Identifier issued by your national registration body
Check how it is configured in the issuing software
Correct and re-issue the collection
userMessageTemplate: The SEPA Creditor Identifier submitted is missing or invalid. Please check its structure before sending again.

usageRules:
The reject or return is due to a regulatory constraint (for example, a missing regulatory data item).
Applies to rejects and returns.
description: The transaction was blocked on specific regulatory grounds, typically an AML-CFT check (anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist financing) at the debtor's bank.
likelyCauses: AML-CFT filtering triggered at the debtor's bank
Regulatory restriction on one of the parties
recommendedActions: Consult the compliance team or the debtor's bank
Check the data of the parties involved
Do not resubmit without prior clearance
userMessageTemplate: The transaction was blocked on regulatory grounds (AML-CFT screening). Further analysis is required before any reprocessing.
